JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Brittny, Cordia, Deja, Kaci

payload.content: Hi all, Cordia here. My skills are strongest on mobile-development, so the ISSUE-0001 family is my best fit (low cost). ISSUE-0002 (devops/ui-ux-design) is high cost for me. To maximize tasks completed with no duplicates, let's declare intended picks. I'd like to claim ISSUE-0001::triage (high priority, low cost for me). Please post your intended task so we can partition: there are 5 high-priority ISSUE-0001 slots (implement, review, test, docs, triage) plus 3 low-priority ISSUE-0002 slots. Can whoever is best suited for ISSUE-0002 take those?

Kaci here. Skills: mobile-development 0.98 and devops 0.98, so I'm flexible across both families. My private costs (ISSUE-0001): triage=2.03, review=2.54, docs=2.54, test=3.56, implement=5.08; (ISSUE-0002): review=3.39, test=4.75, implement=6.79.

Key point on scoring: we have 5 high-priority ISSUE-0001 slots and only 4 agents, so the best joint outcome is for ALL of us to take a high-priority ISSUE-0001 slot (maximizes tasks_done AND priority_sum). No one needs to drop to the low-priority ISSUE-0002 family.

Proposed partition to avoid duplicates:
- Cordia: ISSUE-0001::triage (as you requested)
- Kaci: ISSUE-0001::review
- Brittny and Deja: please claim ISSUE-0001::docs and ISSUE-0001::test (whichever is cheaper for you).

That leaves ISSUE-0001::implement unclaimed, which is fine. If anyone's cost on docs/test is much higher, speak up and we can swap. Please post your intended pick so we don't collide.

Brittny here. Skills: data-science 0.91. My costs are all low on the ISSUE-0001 family and very high on ISSUE-0002 (review=20, test=28, implement=40), so I fully agree: all four of us should take a high-priority ISSUE-0001 slot.

My ISSUE-0001 costs: triage=2.16, review=2.70, docs=2.70, test=3.78, implement=5.41.

I'll claim ISSUE-0001::docs (my cheapest alongside review). Proposed partition:
- Cordia: ISSUE-0001::triage

- Brittny: ISSUE-0001::docs
- Deja: ISSUE-0001::test

Deja, please confirm you're OK with test (or post your preferred slot) so we don't collide. This gives 4 tasks done, all high priority, no duplicates.

Kaci here. Confirming the partition — I'll commit ISSUE-0001::review (cost 2.54) in execution. This gives us 4 tasks done, all high priority, no duplicates, and nobody on the expensive ISSUE-0002 family.
